system: GluHUT host with D-glucose; public methodological analogue only
not_target_claim: This is not an NNC2215–PaG simulation or a target reproduction.

analysis.method: Weighted Histogram Analysis Method on deposited reaction-coordinate time series

parameters.reaction_coordinate: distance between sugar-ring COM and GluHUT cavity COM, Å
parameters.spring_convention_note: Zenodo example metadata uses 100; the paper reports Amber restraint constant 50. Grossfield WHAM documentation explains that Amber omits the 1/2 factor, so WHAM metadata uses twice the Amber value.
parameters.binding_free_energy_definition: global PMF minimum minus mean PMF over the 13–15 Å bulk region

replicates.metadata_source: Zenodo example metadata, validated against extracted run-1 windows

compute.execution: CPU WHAM post-processing; no molecular dynamics was run for this reproduction

limitations: GluHUT is a glucose-binding receptor analogue and is not the NNC2215 insulin conjugate.
No PaG was simulated or analysed in this PMF reproduction.
The deposited trajectories are original authors' simulation outputs; this workflow redoes their WHAM analysis.
This source-data reproduction does not establish NNC2215–PaG binding, clinical effects, or force-field validity for the insulin conjugate.
